BetterAnimations 2.1.15 by arg0NNY / okdevme
Source: https://github.com/okdevme/BetterAnimations
Original plugin supplied by the user: BetterAnimations.plugin.js
License: MIT (see LICENSE). Bundled dependency notices remain in engine.js.

Cutcord/Vencord adaptation:
- Scoped compatibility API; no global BetterDiscord runtime or library installer.
- Vencord settings, native form components and notifications.
- Complete animation engine, pack framework, catalog and a native JSON pack editor.
- Dedicated pack storage through bounded native file operations.
- Discord component declaration capture and current React component compatibility.
- Current channel-row refs and sidebar enum; native settings shell and scroller.
- Startup after the main Discord UI mounts, and cleanup on disable.
- Donation buttons removed; original author and source links retained.

Discord's removed legacy toast and composer-anchor APIs are optional in this
port. Notifications use the native adapter; modern popovers retain their own
positioning. The upstream animation error inspector remains available.
